<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/projects/{projectId}/model-bindings/resolved"}

Batch form of `GET .../agent-bindings/:agentSlug` and `GET .../area-bindings/:areaKey`: each requested key gets EXACTLY the value its single-key route answers (same cascade, same origins, `null` when no level has a model). It exists so the Settings tab reads 20 resolved bindings with one request instead of 20 — the rate limit is per USER. Keys are comma-separated, deduplicated, and a malformed key or more than 64 keys in total is 400, never silently dropped.
